notes.en: Aimed for a readable engraved study with clear dual-pose separation at all sizes. The torso carries anatomical shaping with tapered waist and visible musculature through three etch tiers. Hands and feet are small but present with individual fingers at large render. Weaknesses: the raised arms remain thinner than the horizontal pair, the spread-leg feet are compact, and the face is functional rather than expressive. The bold gold base holds well at navbar size, with the etch detail falling away progressively below 96px.
